description: Lean REVIEW: no simplify step, one self-check recheck after a fix, writers run targeted checks only; integration children skip REVIEW and the parent reviews them all at once (task.py integrate)
changelog: REVIEW is leaner: simplify is no longer a step (run it on demand with arbor.py override --role simplify; Cleanup-lite is an angle of the candidate readers); standard / full enter the candidate readers straight after a green gate. After every fix, in every tier, the gate measures the fix delta: at most mandate.auto_merge_max_lines lines get one self-check reader over last_reviewed..HEAD, more reopen the candidate cycle over the delta (this also re-reviews a fix after the full-tier sweep). Writer roles (implement, fix, simplify) run only the contract's auto checks plus lint and typecheck before committing; put the full test suite in gate.commands, GATE is the one place it runs. A child started on its parent's integration branch skips REVIEW (task.json review_deferred): BUILD -> GATE -> automatic merge. Once every child is merged, task.py integrate <parent> moves the parent into the integration worktree and opens REVIEW/candidates over the whole integration range; arbor.py next then drives candidates -> verify -> fix on the integration branch -> gate -> recheck -> FINISH, and arbor.py finish prints the human merge command and cleans up afterwards (the parent's journal entry lists every child). arbor.py --task <parent> run --role review --mode sweep --range and children --cleanup remain for parents created before this version.
migrationGuide: Add the project's full test suite to gate.commands in .arbor/config.yaml (for example pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test): writers no longer run it. A task that sits in REVIEW/simplify when you update: arbor.py override --to REVIEW/candidates --reason "0.9.0: simplify is no longer a step". Children already started under a parent keep reviewing themselves; children started after the update skip REVIEW, and the parent reviews them with task.py integrate <parent> once every child is merged (seed the parent's check.jsonl first). Review local edits to .arbor/agents/implement.md, fix.md and simplify.md: their Verify step now names targeted checks only.
